dict.string: Perch shows a live camera preview under the notch. No frame is ever written to disk unless you press snapshot, and the camera is released — green light off — within half a second of the island closing.
Perch transcribes speech on your Mac, never in the cloud. Audio is not recorded, stored or sent anywhere.
Perch shows your next event in the island and gives you a one-click join button. Your calendar is read on your Mac and never leaves it.

Perch reads the battery level of your AirPods, mouse, keyboard and trackpad so it can show them in the island.
Perch uses your location only to show local weather, and only if you switch the Weather module on. It is off by default.
Perch controls your meeting app so you can mute, stop video and leave a call from the island.
